name: Ancient City of Damascus
description: Damascus's walled old city in Syria has been settled since the third millennium B.C., making it one of the oldest cities in the Middle East. Its maze of lanes holds around 125 monuments, including churches, mosques and Roman-era walls. The highlight is the 8th-century Umayyad Mosque, built on an ancient Assyrian sanctuary. It has been listed as endangered since 2013.
